'''Scott''' used to play Quakeworld in New Zealand in late 90's and early 00's - mostly under the nickname xus or ninjax (which are now too awkward to say in voice). He lanned with the [[Dust2Dust]] (D2D) clan at the LANit venue in Auckland after their triumphant visit to Australia where he focused mostly on team games - [[CTF]], [[TDM]] and [[2on2]]  - while only dueling due to boredom. 

Scott has returned to Quakeworld after almost 20 years and now residing in Australia, again with a keen interest in all things Quakeworld.
